advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Advanced configuration for operators. These settings are optional — the defaults work for most deployments.
advanced.connectivityDesc: NOMAD periodically checks whether it can reach the internet. By default it probes Cloudflare's utility endpoint with a few fallbacks. Set a custom endpoint below if your network blocks the defaults. Leave blank to use the built-in defaults.
advanced.envOverrideMessage: The INTERNET_STATUS_TEST_URL environment variable is set and takes precedence over this setting. Remove it to manage the test URL here.
advanced.testUrlHelp: A single http(s) URL used to check connectivity. Any HTTP response counts as online.
advanced.settingUpdateError: There was an error updating the setting. Please try again.
advanced.errorHttpOnly: Test URL must use http or https.
advanced.errorInvalidUrl: Test URL must be a valid URL (e.g. "https://example.com").

legal.thirdPartyIntro: Project NOMAD™ integrates the following open source projects. We are grateful to their developers and communities:
legal.kiwixDesc: Offline Wikipedia and content reader (GPL-3.0 License)
legal.kolibriDesc: Offline learning platform by Learning Equality (MIT License)
legal.ollamaDesc: Local large language model runtime (MIT License)
legal.cyberchefDesc: Data analysis and encoding toolkit by GCHQ (Apache 2.0 License)
legal.qdrantDesc: Vector search engine for AI knowledge base (Apache 2.0 License)
legal.privacyIntro: Project NOMAD is designed with privacy as a core principle:
legal.privacyZeroTelemetry: NOMAD does not collect, transmit, or store any usage data, analytics, or telemetry.
legal.privacyLocalFirst: All your data, downloaded content, AI conversations, and notes remain on your device.
legal.privacyNoAccounts: NOMAD operates without user accounts or authentication by default.
legal.privacyNetworkOptional: An internet connection is only required to download content or updates. All installed features work fully offline.
legal.contentDisclaimer1: Project NOMAD provides tools to download and access content from third-party sources including Wikipedia, Wikibooks, medical references, educational platforms, and other publicly available resources.
legal.contentDisclaimer2: Crosstalk Solutions, LLC does not create, control, verify, or guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or reliability of any third-party content. The inclusion of any content does not constitute an endorsement.
legal.contentDisclaimer3: Users are responsible for evaluating the appropriateness and accuracy of any content they download and use.
legal.medicalDisclaimer1: Some content available through NOMAD includes medical references, first aid guides, and emergency preparedness information. This content is provided for general informational purposes only.
legal.medicalDisclaimer2: This information is NOT a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
legal.medicalBullet1: Always seek the advice of qualified health providers with questions about medical conditions.
legal.medicalBullet2: Never disregard professional medical advice or delay seeking it because of something you read in offline content.
legal.medicalBullet3: In a medical emergency, call emergency services immediately if available.
legal.medicalBullet4: Medical information may become outdated. Verify critical information with current professional sources when possible.
legal.dataStorageIntro: All data associated with Project NOMAD is stored locally on your device:
legal.appDataValue: Stored in Docker volumes on your local system
legal.dataStorageOutro: You maintain full control over your data. Uninstalling NOMAD or deleting these directories will permanently remove all associated data.

models.intro: Easily manage the {{name}}'s settings and installed models. We recommend starting with smaller models first to see how they perform on your system before moving on to larger ones.
models.dependenciesMissing: {{name}}'s dependencies are not installed. Please install them to manage AI models.
models.chatSuggestionsDesc: Display AI-generated conversation starters in the chat interface
models.flashAttentionDesc: Enables OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION=1 for improved memory efficiency. Disable if you experience instability. Takes effect after reinstalling the AI Assistant.
models.autoThinkingLabel: Use thinking automatically when a model supports it
models.autoThinkingDesc: Sets the default for models that can think. You can still turn thinking on or off for an individual model in the chat window.
models.kbRetrievalDesc: Search your knowledge base for relevant documents before answering. Turn this off to save memory and speed up replies when your knowledge base is small or empty. This is the same switch as the one in the chat window.
models.assistantNameHelp: Give your AI assistant a custom name that will be used in the chat interface and other areas of the application.
models.tasksModelHelp: Small, fast model used for background work like chat titles and suggestions. Leave this set to the chat model to use whichever model the chat is using. Avoid reasoning models here — they are slow at short, aesthetic tasks.
models.kbRelevanceHelp: How closely a knowledge-base passage has to match your question before it is used in an answer. Stricter settings keep unrelated passages out; too strict and genuinely useful ones get dropped too. When nothing clears the bar, the assistant answers from its own knowledge instead.
models.doubleCheckDesc: Before answering, ask the Tasks Model whether the passages found are actually about your question, and leave them out (and uncited) when they are not. Helps most with large libraries like Wikipedia or Project Gutenberg, where something always looks similar. Needs a capable Tasks Model (about 8B parameters or larger); smaller models reject too many good matches. Adds a short delay to every reply.
models.responseStyleHelp: How adventurous the assistant is when picking its next word. Auto follows whatever the model's author recommended and fills in the rest, and suits most people. Focused gives shorter, steadier, more repeatable answers and is the better choice for looking things up. Creative varies its wording more, at some cost to accuracy.
models.contextWindowHelp: How much conversation and knowledge-base context each reply can consider. Auto sizes this per model from its trained limit and your available memory. Choosing a value sets an upper limit — it can lower the window to save memory, but never raises it beyond what a model supports.
models.currentlyInEffect: Currently in effect: {{list}}. Changes take effect for new conversations.
models.noModelsInstalled: No models installed. Browse the model catalog below to get started.
models.remoteConnectionIntro: Connect to any OpenAI-compatible API server — Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, and others are all supported. For remote Ollama instances, the host must be started with
models.remoteUrlPlaceholder: http://192.168.1.100:11434  (or :1234 for OpenAI API Compatible Apps)
models.ollamaOnlyTitle: Model downloading is only supported when using a Ollama backend.
models.ollamaOnlyMessage: If you are connected to an OpenAI API host (e.g. LM Studio), please download models directly in that application.

benchmark.v2Tooltip: NOMAD Score v2 is an uncapped index versus the NOMAD Reference Build, which scores exactly 1000. Higher is better, and there is no ceiling.
benchmark.weightedComposite: Your NOMAD Score is a weighted composite of all benchmark results.
benchmark.shareIntro: Share your benchmark on the community leaderboard. Choose a Builder Tag to claim your spot, or share anonymously.
benchmark.shareAnonymously: Share anonymously (no Builder Tag shown on leaderboard)

benchmark.sharedMessage: Your benchmark has been submitted to the community leaderboard. Thanks for contributing!
benchmark.tokensTooltip: How fast the AI generates text. Higher is better. 30+ tokens/sec feels responsive, 60+ feels instant.
benchmark.ttftTooltip: How quickly the AI starts responding after you send a message. Lower is better. Under 500ms feels instant.
benchmark.noAiDataDesc: Run a Full Benchmark or AI Only benchmark to measure AI inference performance.
